## Implemented offline pipeline

* `ast.TypeRegistry` resolves and shares forward-referenced types;
  `ExpressionCompiler` builds a typed, lexical AST once per used predicate.
  Evaluation short-circuits, restores quantifier bindings on every exit, and
  performs unsigned modular arithmetic with Python integers.
* `composer.DependencyGraph` compiles only root prerequisites, using a lexical
  Kahn ordering. `oracles.TypeCollector` visits each shared type only once.
* `oracles.LayoutBuilder` and `ResultReader` use the same aggregate reservations
  as `MainBuilder`. `wire.decode` enforces the exact symbolic inventory before
  value recovery; all result values and all string bytes are validated.
* `regex` parses the campaign grammar and matches with an epsilon-NFA and a
  bounded lazy transition cache, rather than a backtracking host regex engine.
* `state.StateMachine` caches distinct guards, minimizes exact `(cost, hops)`
  distances, and reconstructs the lexicographically first optimal command path.
* `run.Corpus` retains input-only, type-preserving identity and every witness's
  own model result. `offline.execute` enforces transport, attestation, filtering,
  reachability, and deduplication in that order.

Local regressions, including randomized shortest-path comparisons:

```
cd project
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

The CLI supports isolated invocation (`python3 -I -B campaign_cli.py`) and needs
only the Python standard library. No generated C execution or online service is
part of certificate production.
